Norway and Portugal meet in the Nations League in what is possibly the standout fixture of the entire international break. Erling Haaland continued his ludicrous goalscoring form for both club and country with two more strikes to seal a 3-2 victory for the Norwegians. With Portugal looking to retain the title they won in 2025 and Norway aiming to continue their ascendancy on the international stage, this has all the makings of a brilliant game. Norway are full of goals at both ends, as seen by their 3-2 victory over Denmark, and Haaland is a near-banker to score at some point. His two in the win over Denmark makes it a frankly insane 29 from his last 16 internationals and he has only failed to score in one of those games — against England in the World Cup quarter-final.

data.title: Cristiano Ronaldo vs. Jorge Jesus beef, explained: Breaking down emergency meeting with Portugal coach and star player -
data.content: As the twilight of Cristiano Ronaldo's career trudges on, the 41-year-old superstar remains vital to his national team — but maybe not as vital as he would like to be at his age. After criticisms of his place within the Portugal national team grew louder during the World Cup, many wondered whether he would become more of a rotation player under new coach Jorge Jesus. The Sporting News explains why Ronaldo is reportedly furious with Jesus and what it could mean for the future of his national team career. Now, as Portugal get ready for their next match Denmark on Thursday, Ronaldo has found himself embroiled in a feud with head coach Jorge Jesus over his place in the national team. Thus, he will not have taken well to any suggestion that he should sit, whether it be because the coach is rotating the squad or he has lost his place. It's certainly feasible that Jorge Jesus could be fired as coach of the Portugal national team if this situation is not resolved.
